executive_decision.one_paragraph_thesis_en: Gold is trading at $4520 with a 0.85% upside, buoyed by a weaker DXY at 103.93. The pullback to the $4500‑$4510 zone offers a high‑probability entry. Technicals show a bullish reversal candle and an intact upward trendline from the London session. Risk management calls for a stop below $4475 and a 1% capital risk per trade.
